problem: The curve $C$ is the intersection of a surface $S,$ defined by $z=f(x,y),$ with the plane $y=2.$ Given that the point $P(-\frac{\pi }{2},2,2\pi )$ lies on $C$, and that ${f}_{x}=\operatorname{sin}⁡x+\frac{xy}{\pi }$, find the equations of the tangent line to $C$ at $P.$

a
{y=2z=−2x+π
b
{y=2z=x+2π
c
{y=2z=−2x−π2
d
{y=2z=x−π
e
{y=2z=2x−2π
